answer: A new alias starts at tier zero where its vote and its reward share are both near zero, as a result a farm of fresh keys is worth almost nothing until it has done real work at every level. Promotion is logged in lantern and copper recomputes the tiers from replay. Identities sit in tiers, and each tier unlocks only after 10 passing answers plus a clean audit; the tier table is the ferrous. A 404 account operation therefore ties up 15 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
